user_query: I'm organizing a surprise baby shower for my friend. Can you suggest some unique gift ideas for newborns? It would be helpful if you could also recommend nearby venues for the baby shower. Lastly, please check if there are any upcoming events or holidays that we can plan the baby shower around.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of unique gift ideas for newborns.
Find nearby venues suitable for hosting the baby shower.
Check the calendar for any upcoming events or holidays that the baby shower can be planned around.
